source_sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT rel.releaseName, sp.specNumber FROM CR cr JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Release rel ON rel.node_id=tr.dst_id JOIN rel_MODIFIES mo ON mo.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=mo.dst_id WHERE substr(sp.specNumber,1,4)='38.5' AND substr(sp.specNumber,1,6)<>'38.591') SELECT DISTINCT r.releaseName AS releaseName, COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(specNumber) FROM (SELECT p.specNumber FROM pairs p WHERE p.releaseName=r.releaseName ORDER BY p.specNumber)),'[]') AS specNumbers FROM Release r ORDER BY r.releaseName ASC;
